# DryRunZ

> DryRunZ is an employee-enablement platform that helps frontline teams improve through realistic, AI roleplay simulations of live interactions — by voice (speech-to-speech) and by text — with personalized coaching and performance feedback. Built on advanced large language models.

## What it is
Frontline employees practice real interactions against AI counterparts before those conversations happen for real. Each run returns individual coaching, concrete tips, and performance feedback. Simulations run in two modes: speech-to-speech (voice) and text.

## How it's different
- Strict zero-data policy: DryRunZ does not require customers to hand over confidential data or grant access to internal systems (CRM, records, knowledge base).
- Proprietary methods keep the simulations realistic and continuously improving without ever touching sensitive corporate data.
- A minimal security footprint means regulated enterprises — including large fintech companies and card issuers — can deploy fast.

## Key capabilities
- Fully custom simulations you build yourself.
- Automatic simulations that adapt to each rep's needs on the fly.
- Personalized, individual coaching, tips, and performance scoring.
- Voice (speech-to-speech) and text practice.

## Languages
Strong multilingual focus. English is fully supported, with special emphasis on non-English languages.

## Who it's for
Frontline and customer-facing teams across many segments — sales, customer support, healthcare, and virtually any frontline role — plus the learning and development teams that train them, including regulated industries such as fintech.
